udp9090.wire_note: SN@P header decode used by outbreak-tools: type=byte0>>4, length=((byte0&0x0f)<<8)|byte1, opcode=bytes2-3 big-endian. Body offset is treated as 0x10 when present.

0x002d.name: REGISTER_OK
0x002d.notes: Handler decrypts response, compares auth, stores host/port/tail fields.

0x000a.name: selector_family_or_state_push
0x000a.notes: Routes through dispatcher paths described in prior findings; use current packet timeline and callback ownership before interpretation.

0x0028.name: selector_family_dispatch
0x0028.notes: Prior findings tie selector body parsing to slot routing. Do not assume current callback ownership without snapshot evidence.

0x0031.name: connection_establish_result_family
